name: Project: Comiket
source:
Summer is here and Noa Natsume decides to help her dear friend, Ren Ogawa, with his doujinshi. After all, Comiket is just around and he still hasn't finished his work!

With Noa staying in his home, can they finish on time or will other things happen and destroy their goal?

[From [url=https://shalie-xy.itch.io/project-comiket]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
盛夏来临，夏目乃亚决定去帮挚友小川莲赶制同人志原稿——毕竟Comiket同人展近在眼前，可他的稿子却还没画完！

随着乃亚住进他家留宿帮忙，两人究竟能否按时完稿，还是会擦出别的火花、把赶稿大计搅得一团糟呢？

[摘自[url=https://shalie-xy.itch.io/project-comiket]itch.io[/url]]
